title: AG60006: Climate Change In Agricultural Production
text:
Syllabus
Syllabus mentioned in ERP

Climate and Agriculture: Climatic requirement for crop growth and development,
Issues and approaches to climate change; Climate change, agriculture and
sustainability. Impact Assessment: Assessing climate change impacts on
agriculture; Use of crop models for climate change impact assessment;
Hydrological cycle; Soil carbon sequestration .Food Security: Climate change
and tropical agriculture; Climate change and organic agriculture; Crop
production in dryland regions; Risk assessment and food security.Adaptation
Strategies: Climate change, global agriculture and regional vulnerability;
Evaluation of adaptation strategies; Research and development for countering
climate change.
